summary.text: John Arthur is a Democratic member of the Utah House of Representatives for District 41 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
A teacher, he was named the 2021 Utah Teacher of the Year, and he joined the House in December 2025 after district delegates appointed him to replace Gay Lynn Bennion.

paragraphs.text: John Arthur earned a B.A. in English language and literature from the University of Utah and an M.Ed. in elementary education and teaching and an M.A. in teaching from Westminster University.

According to Ballotpedia, his career has included work as a teacher, an adjunct professor in the Graduate School of Education at Westminster University, director of candidate recruitment for the Utah National Board Coalition, and co-director of the nonprofit Teacher Fellows.

He was the 2021 Utah Teacher of the Year and a National Teacher of the Year finalist, and he has served on the boards of the National Board for Professional Teaching Standards, WestEd, REL West and IncludEd United.
Arthur was appointed to the Utah House of Representatives District 41 by district delegates on December 7, 2025, to replace Gay Lynn Bennion.
The Democratic primary for the seat on June 23, 2026, was canceled, and the National Education Association is among the groups Ballotpedia lists as endorsing him.
